subject: Refund for my new monthly plan
body: Hi, I signed up for the Pro monthly plan 5 days ago but it turns out my company already pays for SkyVault. Can I get my money back? How long would a refund take?

subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hello, my card statement shows two charges of USD 18 for invoice INV-20931 on the same day. Please fix this.

subject: Desktop app not syncing
body: My laptop app has said Paused for two days and new files are not uploading. What should I do?

subject: Everything is down??
body: SkyVault is down for our whole office since 8am. Every page gives a 503 error and nobody can open shared files. We have a client deadline today.

subject: Folder is empty after update
body: After the app updated last night my Projects folder is completely empty, and the files are not in Trash either. Years of work were in there.

subject: Strange sign-in
body: I got an email that someone signed in to my account from a country I have never visited, and my password no longer works. I think my account was hacked.

subject: Love the new sharing options
body: Just wanted to say the new password-protected links are great. It would be even better if I could set a default expiry date for all links.

subject: Payment failed again
body: My payment failed. This is the fourth time I am writing this week and nobody has answered.

subject: Refund on annual plan
body: Our annual Business plan renewed 3 months ago. We are moving to another provider. Can we get a refund for the rest of the year?

subject: Change my login email
body: I am leaving my old company and want to move my personal SkyVault account to my gmail address. How do I change it?
